name: jetpos-panel
description: JetPos rol panelleri (Patron / Mutfak / Garson) için PC masaüstü kabuğu
author: JetPos

scripts.dev:patron: node scripts/set-role.js patron && cross-env ROLE=patron electron .
scripts.dev:mutfak: node scripts/set-role.js mutfak && cross-env ROLE=mutfak electron .
scripts.dev:garson: node scripts/set-role.js garson && cross-env ROLE=garson electron .
scripts.build:all: npm run build:patron && npm run build:mutfak && npm run build:garson
